Title: Old City walking tour
Description: Guided walk through İçərişəhər: the Maiden Tower, the Palace of the Shirvanshahs, old caravanserais and hidden courtyards.
PhotoCredit: Derek Jones, CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

Title: Gobustan & mud volcanoes day trip
Description: Day trip to Gobustan National Park to see ancient rock carvings and the bubbling mud volcanoes nearby.
PhotoCredit: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

Title: Ateshgah & Yanar Dag evening tour
Description: Evening tour of the Ateshgah fire temple and Yanar Dag, the hillside where natural gas has burned for centuries.
PhotoCredit: Diego Delso, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

Title: Baku Boulevard boat ride
Description: Short cruise on the Bay of Baku with views of the Boulevard, the Old City walls and the Flame Towers.

Title: Heydar Aliyev Center visit
Description: Entry to the Zaha Hadid-designed cultural center, with its flowing architecture and changing exhibitions.

Title: Azerbaijani cooking class
Description: Hands-on class with a local cook: prepare plov, dolma and pakhlava, then share the meal together.
PhotoCredit: Urek Meniashvili, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons
